hook: Qadir Ali Baig Theatre Festival returns for *21st* edition
hook_b: Qadir Ali Baig Theatre Festival returns for *21st* edition
tldr: The 21st Qadir Ali Baig Theatre Festival brings plays, films, masterclasses and workshops.

beats.what: Rakesh Bedi performs Massage; Raghubir Yadav performs Piano; films include Yatra and Jait Re Jait.
beats.why: The festival is held in memory of theatre veteran Qadir Ali Baig, curated by Mohammad Ali Baig.
beats.care: Masterclasses and a children's theatre workshop are part of the line-up.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: workshops include Language of Light and Theatre for Children.

fact: Hyderabad's Qadir Ali Baig Theatre Festival runs *Nov 12-20* with Raghubir Yadav, Deepti Naval.
twist: Shows are traditionally followed by Hyderabadi chowki dinners at the Baig family's haveli.
